content.title: Reading: Incomplete Sentences
content.scenario_summary: Independent workplace and everyday business sentences spanning training, services, events, and operations.

questions.prompt: The trainer will use all sixty minutes for introductions, leaving {{q1}} time for questions during the session.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 no 表示沒有時間。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 整段訓練時間都由介紹占用，因此訓練期間沒有提問時間；time 在此指不可數的時間量。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: many 修飾可數複數名詞，不適合此處的 time。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: no time 表示沒有時間，符合整段時間已被占用的語境。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: several 修飾可數複數名詞，不能直接修飾此處的 time。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: few 修飾可數複數名詞，不適合此處的 time。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先判斷名詞的可數性，再依上下文確定數量。

questions.prompt: The microphones that {{q2}} intermittent noise during recording are awaiting repair at the audio shop.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 produce 與 microphones 一致。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 關係子句中的 that 指 microphones，並作子句主詞；複數先行詞搭配原形動詞 produce。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: produce 與複數 microphones 一致，表示這些麥克風產生雜音。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: produces 是第三人稱單數形式，與此處的複數先行詞不一致。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: producing 不能單獨充當此關係子句的限定動詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: has produced 的 has 與複數先行詞 microphones 不一致。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 關係子句的動詞要依其主詞及先行詞判斷一致性。

questions.prompt: The conference venue {{q3}} the committee inspected last week has a larger lobby than the current site.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 which 指受檢視的場地。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 關係子句已有主詞 the committee，inspected 尚缺受詞；which 可指前面的 venue 並擔任受詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: where 表示地點，不能在此直接充當 inspected 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 通常指人，這裡的先行詞 venue 是場地。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 指 venue，並作 inspected 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所屬關係，後面通常要有被修飾的名詞，此處沒有。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找出關係子句中缺少的成分，再判斷先行詞。

questions.prompt: Members may reserve the coworking studio after hours {{q4}} they return the access card by noon the next day.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 provided that 引出預約條件。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 歸還門禁卡是會員使用空間的條件；provided that 後接完整子句，表示「只要」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: unless they return 表示「如果他們不歸還」；整句會說除非歸還卡片，否則可以預約，與要求歸還作為條件的意思相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: whereas 表示對照，不能表達此處的使用條件。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: although 表示讓步，不能表達歸還卡片的條件。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: provided that 表示只要隔天中午前歸還卡片，即可預約使用。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 條件連接詞要同時符合句子結構與條件的正負方向。

questions.prompt: The caterer can serve the smaller reception as {{q5}} as the banquet, using the same kitchen team.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 efficiently 修飾 serve。
explanation.reasoning_zh: as...as 表示同等程度；空格修飾動詞 serve，應用副詞 efficiently。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: efficient 是形容詞，無法在此直接修飾動作 serve。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: efficiently 是副詞，構成 as efficiently as，表示服務效率相同。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: efficiency 是名詞，不能放在此比較結構中修飾 serve。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: more efficient 是形容詞比較級，不符合此處 as...as 的形式及副詞位置。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 同等比較中的詞性由它所修飾的成分決定。

questions.prompt: {{q6}} by the sudden change in loading instructions, the dispatchers asked the warehouse manager for clarification.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 Confused 描述調度員的感受。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句首分詞片語的邏輯主詞是 dispatchers；他們因指示變動感到困惑，因此用過去分詞 confused。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Confused 描述調度員受到指示變動影響而困惑。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Confusing 表示造成困惑，與此處人員作為感受者的關係不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Confusion 是名詞，不能在此形成修飾 dispatchers 的分詞片語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Confuse 是動詞原形，不能在此形成所需的分詞片語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分人的感受與事物造成感受的作用。

questions.prompt: The subscription can {{q7}} online at any time before the next billing date.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 be cancelled 表示訂閱可被取消。
explanation.reasoning_zh: subscription 是取消動作的對象；情態動詞 can 後用 be 加過去分詞，形成被動語態。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: cancel 為主動原形，使 subscription 成為取消動作的執行者，與此處關係不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: have cancel 的動詞形式不完整；have 後若構成完成式須接過去分詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: be cancelled 是情態動詞後的被動形式，表示訂閱可被取消。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: be cancelling 是進行式，讓訂閱執行取消動作，不符合此處意思。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷主詞與動作的關係，再選情態動詞後的語態。

questions.prompt: The museum commissioned {{q8}} replicas that match the original sculptures in every detail, including size, color, and surface texture.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 faithful 表示忠實呈現原作的。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 複製品在尺寸、顏色及表面紋理等每個細節上都與原雕塑相符，因此 faithful replicas 描述忠於原作的複製品。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: incomplete 指不完整，與複製品符合原作每個細節的描述相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: inaccurate 指不精確，與複製品每個細節都符合原作相反。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: distorted 指變形或失真的，與複製品每個細節都符合原作相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: faithful 指忠實呈現原作，符合複製品每個細節與原作相符的描述。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 用句中的具體細節判斷形容詞與名詞的搭配。

questions.prompt: The cast {{q9}} the final scene with the director tomorrow morning; the rehearsal room has already been booked.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 is rehearsing 表示已安排的未來活動。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 明天上午排練且排練室已訂妥，呈現具體安排；現在進行式可用於這類未來安排。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: rehearsed 是過去式，與明天的安排不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: is rehearsing 可表示已安排於明天進行的排練。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: has rehearsed 表示到現在已排練，與此處明天才進行的安排不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: had rehearsed 表示相對於過去某時已完成，與明天的安排不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 現在進行式可依語境表示具體安排好的未來活動。

questions.prompt: The editor confirmed {{q10}} the newspaper would publish the correction in Saturday's edition.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 that 引導確認的內容。
explanation.reasoning_zh: confirmed 後的完整子句有主詞 the newspaper 與動詞 would publish；that 可引導此內容子句。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: that 引導完整子句，說明編輯確認了什麼。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: during 是介系詞，此處後接完整子句而非適合的名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: despite 是介系詞，不能直接引導這個完整子句作 confirmed 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: because of 是介系詞片語，不能直接引導此完整內容子句。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 確認動詞後若接完整的陳述內容，可考慮 that 子句。

questions.prompt: The harbor tour needs {{q11}} boarding ramps that staff can fold and carry from one boat to another.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 portable 表示便於攜帶的。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 需要工作人員能夠折疊並搬往其他船隻的登船斜坡，因此 portable 這類便於攜帶的斜坡符合需求。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: portable 指便於攜帶，符合折疊後搬往其他船的需求。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: immovable 指無法移動，與需將斜坡搬到其他船隻相反。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: built-in 指內建的，與需要搬往其他船隻的獨立斜坡不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: permanently attached 指永久固定，與需搬到其他船隻的用途相反。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 以具體使用需求區分設備的功能。

questions.prompt: The store's return instructions are {{q12}} clear, leaving customers in no doubt about how to request a refund.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 perfectly 與 clear 搭配表示程度。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句中指出顧客對退款方式毫無疑問；perfectly clear 表示說明十分清楚，副詞修飾形容詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: barely 表示幾乎不，與顧客毫無疑問的情況相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: perfectly 修飾 clear，表示說明十分清楚，符合毫無疑問的語境。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: scarcely 表示幾乎不，與說明讓顧客毫無疑問相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: marginally 表示只有些微程度，與顧客毫無疑問不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 程度副詞與形容詞之間要考慮自然搭配。

questions.prompt: The repair shop ordered a new {{q13}} of inner tubes after using the last one in stock.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 shipment 指一批運送的貨物。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 庫存內胎用完後，店家訂購新的一批內胎；shipment of inner tubes 表示運送的一批貨。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: receipt 是收據，不能指訂購的新一批內胎。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: warranty 是保固，不是訂購的一批內胎。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: shipment 指一批運送的貨物，符合補充內胎的情境。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: estimate 是估價，不是所訂購的一批內胎。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依句中物品的用途區分貨物與文件名稱。

questions.prompt: On the overnight train, passengers in the shared compartment introduced themselves to {{q14}} before departure.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 each other 表示彼此。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 共享車廂的乘客互相介紹自己；to each other 表達各人向其他乘客介紹的相互關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: each other 表示彼此，符合乘客互相介紹自己的情境。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: themselves 表示他們自己；introduced themselves to themselves 不表達彼此介紹。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: they 是主格形式，不適合在此作介系詞 to 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: their 是用來修飾名詞的所有格限定詞；此處後面沒有名詞，不能單獨作 to 的受詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 表示參與者之間互相作用時，可用 each other。

questions.prompt: The translation agency explained {{q15}} before the client submitted the files.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 how it would handle revisions 是間接問句。
explanation.reasoning_zh: explained 後接嵌入的 how 問句，子句中採 it would handle 的陳述句語序，而非疑問句倒裝。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: how would it handle revisions 使用直接問句倒裝，不適合作為此處的嵌入問句。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: how it would handle revisions 使用主詞在助動詞前的語序，作 explained 的內容。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: how did it handle revisions 使用直接問句倒裝，不適合此嵌入位置。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: how would handle it revisions 的主詞與動詞位置不符合此子句語序。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 嵌入問句通常保留疑問詞，後面使用陳述句語序。

questions.prompt: The studio's revised design is {{q16}} different from the first proposal in its treatment of natural light.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 markedly 修飾 different。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 different，表示設計在自然光處理上差異顯著，因此使用副詞 markedly。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: marked 是形容詞或過去分詞，不適合在此直接修飾 different。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: marking 是動名詞或現在分詞，不適合此處修飾 different。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: markedly 是副詞，表示差異顯著，修飾 different。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: mark 是名詞或動詞原形，不適合此副詞位置。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 修飾形容詞時，依意思選擇合適的副詞形式。

questions.prompt: The library's meeting room is {{q17}} for booking on Friday afternoon; another group has reserved the entire period.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 unavailable 表示無法預約使用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 另一團體已訂下會議室，因此該時段無法提供給其他使用者，unavailable 符合狀態。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: available 表示可使用，與已有其他團體預訂相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: vacant 側重實際是否空置；此處討論能否預訂，已有預訂支持 unavailable for booking。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: open 表示開放使用，與此時段已被預訂的情況不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: unavailable 表示無法提供使用，符合已有預訂的情境。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 利用預訂或使用狀態判斷資源是否可用。

questions.prompt: The print shop will notify {{q18}} placed the order when the brochures are ready for pickup.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 whoever 同時指人並作子句主詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: notify 的受詞是整個 whoever placed the order 子句；whoever 在子句內作 placed 的主詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whoever 指下訂單的人，並在子句內作 placed 的主詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: whomever 是受格形式，但空格在子句內作 placed 的主詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 指物或從已知選項中選擇，不能在此指未特定的下單者。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所屬關係，不能單獨作 placed 的主詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 複合關係代名詞的格要看它在自身子句中的功能。

questions.prompt: Before joining a class, visitors can take a {{q19}} of the fitness center with a staff member.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 tour 表示參觀。
explanation.reasoning_zh: take a tour of the fitness center 是參觀健身中心；with a staff member 表示有員工陪同。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: trial 指試用或試驗，take a trial of the center 不表達參觀整個場所。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: tour 與 take a 搭配，表示在員工陪同下參觀中心。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: break 指休息，take a break of the fitness center 不符合此處結構與意思。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: turn 指輪次或轉彎，take a turn of the center 不表示此處的導覽參觀。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 留意 take 與名詞及後續介系詞構成的慣用片語。

questions.prompt: The garden committee thanked residents for their {{q20}} of tools for the spring planting day.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 donation 是名詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 介系詞 for 後的片語以 their 表示所屬，空格需要能與 of tools 組成名詞片語的 donation。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: donate 是動詞原形，不能直接接在 their 後構成此名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: donated 是過去分詞或過去式，不能單獨接 their 並與 of tools 構成此片語。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: donation 是名詞，their donation of tools 表示他們捐贈工具。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: donates 是動詞的第三人稱單數形式，不能接在 their 後構成此名詞片語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先確認介系詞後整個名詞片語的結構，再選詞形。

questions.prompt: The professional association issued each attendee a {{q21}} confirming completion of the required training hours.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 certificate 指證書。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文件發給參加者，確認其完成規定的訓練時數；certificate 可作為此項完成證明。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: receipt 是收據，通常記錄款項或物品的收受，不是此處的訓練完成證明。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: invoice 是發票或請款帳單，與確認完成訓練時數的文件功能不同。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: schedule 是時間表，主要列出安排，不是發給個人確認完成時數的證明。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: certificate 是證書，可確認參加者完成規定的訓練時數。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依文件實際執行的功能區分常見文件名稱。

questions.prompt: All shortlisted applicants {{q22}} of their interview times, so no further notifications are needed.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 have been informed 表示已被通知。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 後半句說不需要再通知，顯示通知已完成且結果持續到現在；applicants 是接受通知的人，故用現在完成被動式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: have informed 是現在完成主動式，會使 applicants 成為通知他人的人。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: have been informed 表示申請者已被通知，符合無須再通知的結果。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: are informing 是現在進行主動式，表示申請者正在通知他人，與句意不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: had informed 是過去完成主動式，既把申請者當作通知者，也未表達目前已完成的結果。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先看完成結果的時間關係，再判斷主詞是動作者還是受動者。

questions.prompt: The awards ceremony began shortly {{q23}} the guests had taken their seats.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 after 引導時間子句。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後有主詞 the guests 和動詞 had taken，形成完整子句；after 可引導此時間子句。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: after 可接完整子句，表示來賓就座後典禮開始。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: during 是介系詞，不能直接接此處完整的主詞與動詞子句。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: upon 是介系詞，不能直接接此處的完整子句。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: following 作介系詞時接名詞片語，不能直接接此處完整子句。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨別空格後是完整子句還是名詞片語。

questions.prompt: The elevator passed its inspection; {{q24}}, it remains closed while the lobby floor is repaired.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 nevertheless 表示轉折。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 電梯通過檢查，卻在大廳地板維修期間仍然關閉；兩個事實形成讓步轉折。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: therefore 表示因此，無法表達通過檢查卻仍關閉的轉折。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: likewise 表示同樣地，前後兩件事並非相似的情況。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: nevertheless 表示儘管如此，連接通過檢查和仍然關閉的對比。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: consequently 表示結果，因此不適合表達此處的讓步關係。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 分號後的連接副詞要符合前後句的語意關係。

questions.prompt: The relocation team labeled every cable before {{q25}} the computers for transport.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 disconnecting 接在介系詞 before 後。
explanation.reasoning_zh: before 在此引導時間片語，後接動名詞 disconnecting，表示在拆除電腦連接之前先貼標籤。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: disconnect 是動詞原形，不能直接接在此處的 before 後。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: disconnecting 是動名詞，before disconnecting 表示拆除連接之前。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: disconnected 是過去式或過去分詞，不能單獨作此處 before 的補語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: to disconnect 是不定詞，不能直接接在此處的 before 後。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 介系詞後若以動詞表達動作，可使用動名詞。

questions.prompt: Please {{q26}} the rented projector for use by connecting its power cord and positioning it on a stable table.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 set up 表示設置以供使用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 接上電源線並把投影機放在穩固的桌面上，是準備設備使用的步驟，因此選 set up。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: pack up 指收拾裝箱，與接電並放置設備以供使用的動作不同。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: hand back 指交還，不能描述接電及放置設備的準備動作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: take apart 指拆解，與將投影機設置好以供使用不同。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: set up 指設置或準備使用，符合接電並放置在桌面的動作。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依具體操作步驟判斷片語動詞的意思。

questions.prompt: Please {{q27}} the supplier's address against the order form before mailing the art supplies.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 verify 表示核對。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 寄送前將供應商地址與訂單上的資料比對，是確認資訊是否正確，因此用 verify。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: summarize 指摘要，與將地址和訂單比對的動作不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: verify 指核實，verify the address against the order form 表示比對確認地址。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: distribute 指分發，與此處核對地址的目的不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: translate 指翻譯，與此處比對地址的動作不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依資訊處理的具體目的區分動詞。

questions.prompt: The bookshop will {{q28}} its author talk with a signing session, creating one program that includes both.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 combine 表示將兩項活動結合。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句子說形成一個包含講座與簽名會的節目；combine A with B 表示結合兩者。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: replace A with B 指以 B 取代 A，與單一節目包含兩者的安排不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: contrast A with B 指對照兩者，不能表達將兩項活動組成一個節目。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: combine A with B 指結合兩者，符合形成一個包含兩項活動的節目。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: confuse A with B 指將兩者混淆，不能表達把活動合組成節目。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷動詞與兩個補語的關係是否符合句中的具體結果。

questions.prompt: The team reviewed four package designs; two were rejected, while both {{q29}} designs were selected for production.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 the other，指其餘的設計。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 四款設計中兩款被淘汰，both the other designs 指已知集合中剩下的兩款；the other 在此修飾複數名詞 designs。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: another 不適合放在 both 和複數名詞 designs 之間；此處要指已知集合中其餘的兩款設計。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: others 是代名詞，不能直接接在 both 後並修飾名詞 designs。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: the others 是代名詞片語，不能再直接修飾後面的名詞 designs。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: both the other designs 指已知四款中另外兩款設計，與兩款被淘汰、兩款入選的結果相符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依已知集合與後面的名詞結構，選擇表示其餘成員的限定詞。

questions.prompt: The benefits portal keeps enrollment forms {{q30}} to employees throughout the year.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案 accessible 作受詞補語。
explanation.reasoning_zh: keeps 的受詞是 enrollment forms，accessible 描述表單保持可供員工使用的狀態。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: accessible 是形容詞，補充說明 forms 保持可使用的狀態。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: access 是名詞或動詞，不能在此直接描述 forms 的狀態。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: accessibly 是副詞，不能在此擔任描述 forms 狀態的形容詞補語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: accessibility 是名詞，不能在此直接擔任描述 forms 狀態的補語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: keep 加受詞後可用形容詞說明受詞保持的狀態。

content.title: Central Ordering at a Design Fair
content.scenario_summary: A design fair introduces a central desk that places visitor orders with exhibitors, drawing on a completed trial and issuing tickets with exhibitors’ contact numbers.

documents.title: A New Way to Order at the Fair

blocks.text: A New Way to Order at the Fair

At this year's Northbridge Design Fair, visitors can use a new central ordering desk. Instead of making purchases at individual stands, they submit their purchase requests at the desk. Each request is sent once, unchanged, to the appropriate exhibitor as a new order. Staff there {{q1}} the orders with the exhibitors on the visitors' behalf.

The organizer first tested the service at a small industry show in March. The trial ended on March 12. It {{q2}} two days. Visitors could browse a digital catalog at the desk rather than carry printed catalogs around the hall. Several people welcomed having less to carry. They described the reduction as {{q3}}.

At Northbridge, the desk will also issue a claim ticket for each order. {{q4}} Visitors can call that number directly to reach the exhibitor about their order after the fair. The desk will be open throughout the event.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: place orders 表示下訂單，符合服務台代訪客向參展商訂購的服務。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 訪客將購買請求交給集中服務台，每個請求會原樣且只送一次給參展商作為新訂單，因此員工是代表訪客下單。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: cancel 是取消訂單，與服務台接收購買請求並代為訂購的目的不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: duplicate 是重複建立訂單，與每個請求只送一次作為新訂單不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: place 可與 orders 搭配，表示代表訪客向參展商下訂單。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: revise 是修改訂單，與請求原樣送出的資訊不符。

evidence.quote: Instead of making purchases at individual stands, they submit their purchase requests at the desk. Each request is sent once, unchanged, to the appropriate exhibitor as a new order. Staff there {{q1}} the orders with the exhibitors on the visitors' behalf.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先確認上下文描述的實際動作，再判斷哪個動詞與名詞搭配且符合目的。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: lasted 符合已在三月十二日結束的試辦活動。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前文交代主辦單位三月曾測試服務，並在另一句說明試辦已於三月十二日結束，因此描述該次試辦的持續時間應用過去式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: lasted 是過去式，適合描述已結束的試辦持續了兩天。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: lasts 是現在式，與此處敘述已結束的試辦不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: will last 指未來將持續，與已結束的試辦時間不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: has lasted 將持續時間連到現在，與此處明確已結束的過去試辦不符。

evidence.quote: The organizer first tested the service at a small industry show in March. The trial ended on March 12. It {{q2}} two days.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 時態題可利用前後句交代的時間及事件是否已結束來判斷。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: helpful 符合訪客對減少攜帶物品的正面評價。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前文指出訪客能瀏覽數位目錄，無須帶著紙本目錄走動；另外一句說幾位訪客樂見攜帶物品減少，因此他們認為這項減少有幫助。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: burdensome 是造成負擔的，與訪客樂見攜帶物品減少不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: frustrating 是令人沮喪的，與訪客歡迎這項減少不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: inconvenient 是不方便的，與訪客對這項減少的正面反應不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: helpful 是有幫助的，呼應訪客樂見不必攜帶那麼多物品。

evidence.quote: Visitors could browse a digital catalog at the desk rather than carry printed catalogs around the hall. Several people welcomed having less to carry. They described the reduction as {{q3}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 評價用詞須連結前文的具體經驗及說話者對該經驗的反應。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Each ticket lists the visitor's telephone number.

options.label: B
options.text: Each ticket lists the exhibitor's telephone number.

options.label: C
options.text: Each ticket lists the ordering desk's telephone number.

options.label: D
options.text: Each ticket lists the fair information line's telephone number.

explanation.summary_zh: 票券列出參展商電話，後句的 that number 才能讓訪客直接聯絡參展商。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句介紹每筆訂單的領取憑券，後句說訪客可撥打該號碼直接聯絡參展商，因此空格應在憑券上提供參展商的電話號碼。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 訪客自己的電話無法直接作為聯絡參展商的號碼，與後句不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 憑券列出參展商電話，既承接前句的憑券，也提供後句 that number 的指涉。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 訂購服務台的電話是服務台的聯絡方式，後句卻說可直接聯絡參展商。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 展會資訊專線屬於資訊服務，與後句直接聯絡參展商不符。

evidence.quote: At Northbridge, the desk will also issue a claim ticket for each order. {{q4}} Visitors can call that number directly to reach the exhibitor about their order after the fair.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空要檢查前後文的指涉：找出代名詞或指示詞所需的明確對象。

content.title: Inspection Service Advertisement
content.scenario_summary: An inspection firm advertises scratch tracing for manufactured parts, provides a previous client example, and explains limited November capacity and report delivery.

blocks.text: Find the Source of Scratches
Have you noticed scratches on finished parts but cannot tell when they occur? {{q1}} Our inspector will examine those scratched samples and help trace the damage to a stage in production.

At a recent client's factory, our inspector traced scratches to a worn guide on the production line. The inspection {{q2}} the source of the damage, and the client replaced the guide. Ask us how we can help your team investigate similar problems.

Our team can inspect only six batches in November, with one appointment per batch. {{q3}}, once all six slots are booked, no further November inspections can be scheduled. Your inspection report {{q4}} to you within two business days after the visit. Contact Linton Inspection to reserve a slot.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Send us several undamaged parts for inspection.

options.label: B
options.text: Ask us to inspect the production line without samples.

options.label: C
options.text: Send us several scratched parts for inspection.

options.label: D
options.text: Send us photographs of the packaging for inspection.

explanation.summary_zh: 送交有刮痕的零件，才能承接後句檢查那些有刮痕的樣本。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句提到成品上的刮痕，後句的 those scratched samples 指有刮痕的樣本，因此中間應先請客戶提供這類零件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 未受損的零件不能作為後句所說有刮痕的樣本。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 要求不使用樣本而檢查生產線，無法引出後句所指的有刮痕樣本。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 提供數個有刮痕的零件，讓後句的 those scratched samples 有明確對象。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 包裝照片不是後句要檢查的有刮痕零件樣本。

evidence.quote: Have you noticed scratches on finished parts but cannot tell when they occur? {{q1}} Our inspector will examine those scratched samples and help trace the damage to a stage in production.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空應確認後句的指示詞所指的對象已由前文引入。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: identified 表示辨識出損傷來源，符合前句追查到磨損導件的結果。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說檢查員已將刮痕追溯到生產線上磨損的導件，所以這次檢查找出了損傷來源；客戶接著更換該導件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: overlooked 表示忽略，與檢查員已追查到來源不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: identified 表示辨識出，呼應找到磨損導件是刮痕的來源。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: obscured 表示使來源不清楚，與已追查出來源不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: misidentified 表示錯認來源；文中說明已追查到該導件，並未表示認錯。

evidence.quote: At a recent client's factory, our inspector traced scratches to a worn guide on the production line. The inspection {{q2}} the source of the damage, and the client replaced the guide.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 詞彙題要根據相鄰句描述的具體結果判斷動詞，而非只看搭配。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: Therefore 表示因此，連接檢查量限制與額滿後無法再安排的結果。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說十一月只能檢查六批，後句說六個名額都訂滿後便不能再安排該月檢查，兩句是因果關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Nevertheless 表示儘管如此，但後句是限制的結果，並非與限制相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Previously 表示先前，不能表達此處由容量限制導出的結果。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: In contrast 表示對照，而後句是容量限制的結果，並非相對照的情況。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Therefore 表示因此，連接六批的上限與名額滿後不能再排的結果。

evidence.quote: Our team can inspect only six batches in November, with one appointment per batch. {{q3}}, once all six slots are booked, no further November inspections can be scheduled.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先判斷前後句的邏輯關係，再選擇能表達該關係的連接語。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: will be sent 是未來被動式，表示檢查報告將寄給客戶。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句子的主詞是 inspection report，報告是被寄送的對象；空格後的 to you 表示收件對象，因此需要被動形式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: will send 是主動式，會把報告當成寄送者，不符合此處報告被寄給客戶的意思。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: will be sent 是未來被動式，表示報告將被寄給客戶。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: will have sent 是主動的未來完成式，會把報告當成寄送者。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: will be sending 是主動的未來進行式，會把報告當成寄送者。

evidence.quote: Your inspection report {{q4}} to you within two business days after the visit.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷主詞是執行動作還是接受動作，有助於選擇主動或被動語態。

content.title: A Recycling Customer’s Letter
content.scenario_summary: An office coordinator thanks a recycling service for a driver’s visit, a sorting guide and a gate-access arrangement that enabled collection.

blocks.text: Dear Customer Services Team,

Thank you for the recycling collection at our office last week. Your driver, Mr. Lane, had never visited our building before, so our office manager, Ms. Chen, greeted him at reception. She showed {{q1}} where to park his truck.

Before collecting anything, Mr. Lane gave me a laminated sorting guide. I posted {{q2}} on our noticeboard. Our staff wanted to keep materials your service accepts apart from those it cannot take. The guide helped us {{q3}} the materials to meet that goal before the next pickup.

Our rear gate is locked during collections, but I included its access code in the pickup request. {{q4}} As a result, the driver entered the code and reached the bins without asking our staff to open the gate. We appreciate your team's assistance.

Sincerely,
Mina Park
Office Coordinator

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: him 指初次到訪的司機 Mr. Lane，承接陳小姐向他指示停車位置。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句介紹第一次來此大樓的司機，以及迎接他的辦公室經理陳小姐；後句的 she 指陳小姐，his truck 則呼應司機，因此受指示的人是他。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: her 指女性，但此處陳小姐是指示停車位置的人，接受指示的是司機。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 也可指單一人物，但本文已用 him 和 his 指稱 Mr. Lane，此處延續 him 最自然。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: him 指男性單數司機，符合他初次到訪並需停放卡車的語境。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: us 指包含寫信人在內的群體，不是此處接受指示的司機。

evidence.quote: Your driver, Mr. Lane, had never visited our building before, so our office manager, Ms. Chen, greeted him at reception. She showed {{q1}} where to park his truck.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 追蹤不同句中的人物及其角色，確認代名詞所指的對象。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: it 指前句提到的護貝分類指南。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說司機交給寫信人一份護貝分類指南，接著寫信人把它張貼在布告欄，因此代名詞指該單一物件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: it 可指單一物件，即前句的分類指南。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: him 指男性，不符合張貼在布告欄的指南。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 通常指複數對象；此處張貼的是一份指南。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: us 指包含寫信人的群體，不符合張貼指南的語意。

evidence.quote: Before collecting anything, Mr. Lane gave me a laminated sorting guide. I posted {{q2}} on our noticeboard.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 代名詞可跨句指向前文物件，應確認數量與動作是否相符。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: separate 指分開，符合員工希望將這項服務可收取與不可收取的材料分開的目的。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說明員工希望將服務接受的材料與不能收取的材料分開，故指南幫助他們在下次收取前將材料區分開來。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: weigh 表示稱重，不能表達前句所述的分開兩類材料。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: store 表示存放，單靠存放無法表達將兩類材料分開的目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: count 表示計數，與員工要分開不同材料的目標不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: separate 表示分開，呼應員工要將可收取和不可收取的材料分開。

evidence.quote: Our staff wanted to keep materials your service accepts apart from those it cannot take. The guide helped us {{q3}} the materials to meet that goal before the next pickup.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 結合前文的人員目的，辨別詞語所表示的具體動作。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Your dispatcher asked our staff to open the gate for the driver.

options.label: B
options.text: Your dispatcher passed the code to the driver before collection.

options.label: C
options.text: Your dispatcher sent the code to the driver after collection.

options.label: D
options.text: Your dispatcher told the driver to wait for our staff at the gate.

explanation.summary_zh: 調度員事先把密碼交給司機，使司機能自行到達回收桶。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說後門上鎖，寫信人已在收取請求中附上密碼；後句說司機未請員工開門就抵達回收桶，因此中間應交代司機在收取前取得密碼。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 調度員請員工開門並未交代司機如何取得密碼，也不能解釋後句司機輸入密碼的因果銜接。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 收取前把密碼交給司機，連接前句提供密碼和後句自行到達回收桶的結果。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 收取後才送交密碼，無法解釋司機當次如何利用它抵達回收桶。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 要求司機在門口等員工，不能說明後句他無須請員工開門的結果。

evidence.quote: Our rear gate is locked during collections, but I included its access code in the pickup request. {{q4}} As a result, the driver entered the code and reached the bins without asking our staff to open the gate.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子填空須將前文的條件和後文的結果連成合理的因果關係。

content.title: Refill Pack Customer Research
content.scenario_summary: A household goods company recruits recent refill-pack buyers for interviews, uses pilot observations about opening difficulties to assess interview formats, and explains planned feedback use and participant privacy.

blocks.text: Customer Research: Refill Packs

Merrow Home Goods is inviting customers to interviews about its refill packs. To take part, you must have purchased a refill pack within the past six months. Our questionnaire has been {{q1}} revised to focus on customers' experiences of using the packs.

During a pilot, customers explained by phone how they opened the packs, but they could not easily describe where they had trouble. When researchers met these customers in person, they could see exactly where the difficulties occurred. {{q2}} Participants in the new study can choose either interview format when registering.

The research will lead to a new version of our refill instructions. We intend to put participants' suggestions {{q3}} by incorporating them into that revision. The published summary will contain only combined responses, without names or other identifying details. This will {{q4}} participants' identities. To volunteer, visit merrow.example/research by November 20.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: thoroughly 是副詞，修飾 revised，表示問卷已經過徹底修改。
explanation.reasoning_zh: has been revised 是現在完成式被動語態，此處空格修飾 revised 所表示的修改動作，需用副詞 thoroughly。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: thorough 是形容詞，此處需修飾 revised 所表示的動作，而非直接修飾名詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: thoroughness 是名詞，不能在此位置修飾 revised 這個動作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: thoroughly 是副詞，可修飾 revised，表示修改得很徹底。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: thoroughgoing 是形容詞，不能在此位置充當修飾 revised 的副詞。

evidence.quote: Our questionnaire has been {{q1}} revised to focus on customers' experiences of using the packs.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找出修飾語要描述的成分，再選擇適當詞形。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: In-person interviews can provide insights that phone interviews may miss.

options.label: B
options.text: Phone interviews cannot provide any useful insights into opening the packs.

options.label: C
options.text: Neither interview format can provide insights into opening the packs.

options.label: D
options.text: Phone and in-person interviews provide exactly the same insights into opening the packs.

explanation.summary_zh: 面談能提供電話訪談可能無法取得的見解，符合試辦觀察。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 試辦時，顧客透過電話說明如何開啟補充包，卻難以描述遇到困難的位置；研究人員當面觀察後看到了具體困難。因此，面談可能補足電話訪談未捕捉到的資訊，後文再說明正式研究提供兩種方式供選擇。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 面談可能提供電話訪談遺漏的見解，概括了現場觀察所增加的資訊。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 電話訪談讓顧客說明如何開啟補充包，並非完全無法提供有用資訊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 電話和面談都提供了相關資訊，尤其面談讓研究人員看見困難的具體位置。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 試辦中面談揭示了電話訪談未能清楚呈現的困難位置，兩者提供的資訊並非完全相同。

evidence.quote: During a pilot, customers explained by phone how they opened the packs, but they could not easily describe where they had trouble. When researchers met these customers in person, they could see exactly where the difficulties occurred. {{q2}} Participants in the new study can choose either interview format when registering.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 評估句要根據前文的具體經驗作合理概括，並銜接後續安排。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: put suggestions to use 表示將建議付諸運用，符合計畫把建議納入修訂的做法。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句中的 intend to 表示計畫，by incorporating them into that revision 則說明預定將參與者的建議納入新版說明，也就是計畫運用這些建議。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: to use 與 put 搭配表示付諸運用，符合計畫納入修訂的做法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: on hold 表示暫緩處理，與計畫納入修訂不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: aside 表示擱置，與計畫把建議用於修訂不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: in storage 表示存放起來，與計畫將建議用於修訂不符。

evidence.quote: The research will lead to a new version of our refill instructions. We intend to put participants' suggestions {{q3}} by incorporating them into that revision.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 理解搭配語的意思，並確認它符合句中說明的預定做法。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: protect 表示保護，呼應摘要不含姓名或其他可識別身分的細節。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說公開摘要僅呈現彙整後的回應，且不含姓名或其他可識別個人的細節；這樣做的作用是保護參與者身分。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: reveal 表示揭露身分，與省略可識別細節的做法相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: verify 表示確認身分，彙整回應並省略識別資料並不是在確認身分。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: protect 表示保護身分，符合摘要不含個人識別細節的效果。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: alter 表示改變身分；省略識別細節不會改變參與者本身的身分。

evidence.quote: The published summary will contain only combined responses, without names or other identifying details. This will {{q4}} participants' identities.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先釐清指示詞 this 所指的前文做法，再判斷該做法的結果。

content.title: Reading: Book Exchange Advertisement
content.scenario_summary: A book exchange recruits volunteers, adding Saturday shifts for workers and sharing a volunteer’s positive unexpected visitor-facing experience.

blocks.text: Make Room for Stories

Join the PageBridge volunteer team at our neighborhood book exchange. Volunteers sort donated books and help visitors find something to read. Several volunteers told us they could not attend our weekday sessions because of their work schedules, so we have added Saturday shifts.

One volunteer, Mina Lee, shares her experience: “When I signed up, I was told I would spend my shift sorting donations. Instead, I helped visitors choose books. Hearing what they hoped to read made the time fly, so I signed up for another shift at the visitors’ table.”
Shifts last three hours, and a team leader is always on hand to help. To see available dates and sign up, visit pagebridge.example/volunteer.

questions.prompt: Why did PageBridge add Saturday shifts?

options.label: A
options.text: To give new volunteers extra training time

options.label: B
options.text: To accommodate volunteers with weekday jobs

options.label: C
options.text: To keep the book exchange open after work

options.label: D
options.text: To let volunteers work without a team leader

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 B：配合平日工作的志工。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 廣告明說有些志工因工作時間無法參加平日場次，因此增設週六班次；選項以 weekday jobs 重述這個原因。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章沒有說增設週六班次是為了增加新志工訓練時間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 平日工作使部分志工無法參加原有場次，這正是增設週六班次的原因。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章沒有將下班後開放書籍交換站列為增設週六班次的原因。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 廣告說班次中有組長可提供協助，並非讓志工自行工作。

evidence.quote: Several volunteers told us they could not attend our weekday sessions because of their work schedules, so we have added Saturday shifts.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 尋找因果連接詞前後的資訊，區分增設措施的原因與其他可能結果。

questions.prompt: What does Mina Lee’s experience suggest about her?

options.label: A
options.text: She would rather sort books without visitors.

options.label: B
options.text: She wants volunteers to have longer shifts.

options.label: C
options.text: She finds helping visitors choose books rewarding.

options.label: D
options.text: She feels unprepared to work at the exchange.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 C：她覺得協助訪客選書很有收穫。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Mina 實際幫訪客選書，聽他們談想讀的書使她覺得時間過得很快；她又報名訪客桌的班次，可推知她喜歡這項工作。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她再次報名訪客桌，而不是表示寧願避開訪客整理書籍。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她報名另一個班次，但沒有表示希望每個班次延長。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 訪客分享閱讀期待使她覺得時間飛逝，她也再次報名，顯示她從這項協助中獲得樂趣。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她描述了愉快的經驗並再次報名，沒有顯示她覺得自己準備不足。

evidence.quote: Instead, I helped visitors choose books.
Hearing what they hoped to read made the time fly, so I signed up for another shift at the visitors’ table.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 結合人物對經驗的描述與後續行動，推論其態度。

blueprint.event: a difference between a promise and an experience

content.title: Reading: Courtyard Project Chat
content.scenario_summary: A nursery delivery delay changes a courtyard planting plan, and team members divide responsibility for updating the plan and notifying the building manager.

blocks.text: The nursery just called. The courtyard trees will not arrive until Thursday because its delivery truck broke down this morning.
blocks.speaker: Leah Chen

blocks.text: Thanks for letting me know. As the landscape architect for this courtyard, I’ll update the planting plan to fit the new delivery date.
blocks.speaker: Nora Ellis

blocks.text: Great. We still need someone to tell the building manager about the delay before her meeting at noon.
blocks.speaker: Leah Chen

blocks.text: I can take care of that.
blocks.speaker: Amir Shah

blocks.text: Thanks, Amir. Please mention that the stone path can still be installed on Wednesday.
blocks.speaker: Leah Chen

blocks.text: Will do. I’ll call her now and include the path schedule.
blocks.speaker: Amir Shah

questions.prompt: What is Nora Ellis’s role on the courtyard project?

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 C：她負責景觀設計。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Nora 在對話中直接說自己是這座庭院的 landscape architect，並會更新種植計畫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 建築經理是需要接獲延誤通知的人，Nora 說自己的身分是景觀設計師。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章提到苗圃的配送卡車故障，但 Nora 並非文中指認的苗圃司機。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Nora 自稱是庭院的 landscape architect，也就是負責景觀設計的人。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 對話說石徑仍可如期鋪設，但沒有說 Nora 負責施工。

evidence.quote: As the landscape architect for this courtyard, I’ll update the planting plan to fit the new delivery date.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 留意說話者直接說明的身分，避免把其他人的職責混在一起。

questions.prompt: What does Amir mean when he writes, “I can take care of that”?

options.label: A
options.text: He will update the planting plan.

options.label: B
options.text: He will notify the building manager.

options.label: C
options.text: He will contact the nursery about its truck.

options.label: D
options.text: He will arrange the stone path installation.

questions.target_text: I can take care of that.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 B：他願意通知建築經理。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Leah 剛說還需要有人告知建築經理延誤一事，Amir 隨即表示可以處理，之後又說要打電話給她。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 更新種植計畫是 Nora 在前一則訊息承擔的工作，並非 Amir 此處回應的任務。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Amir 承接 Leah 提出的通知工作，並表示會打電話給建築經理。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 苗圃已就卡車問題來電；Amir 此處回應的是通知建築經理的需求。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Leah 後來請 Amir 提及石徑仍可如期施工，並未請他安排施工。

evidence.quote: We still need someone to tell the building manager about the delay before her meeting at noon.
I can take care of that.
I’ll call her now and include the path schedule.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解讀代名詞 that 的指涉時，要結合前一則需求及後續回應。

content.title: Reading: Wholesale Order Chat
content.scenario_summary: A café changes the number of rolls per bag; bakery staff obtain an editable label and coordinate the revised proof and delivery schedule.

blocks.text: Harbor Café has changed tomorrow’s wholesale order: it wants six rolls per bag instead of twelve. The total number of rolls is unchanged.
blocks.speaker: Rina Cho

blocks.text: Our label still says twelve, and the file I have is locked. Do you have an editable copy?
blocks.speaker: Owen Bell

blocks.text: Yes, I’ll send you the label file so you can change the count. The café needs the revised proof by 4:00 p.m. today.
blocks.speaker: Rina Cho

blocks.text: Thanks. I’ll update it and send the proof. What time is the order going out?
blocks.speaker: Owen Bell

blocks.text: Packing starts at 6:00 a.m. tomorrow, the truck leaves at 7:15, and delivery to the café is scheduled for 8:00.
blocks.speaker: Rina Cho

questions.prompt: Why does Owen ask, “Do you have an editable copy?”

options.label: A
options.text: To obtain a file he can use to revise the label

options.label: B
options.text: To ask the café to change its order quantity

options.label: C
options.text: To confirm when the order will be delivered

options.label: D
options.text: To request a sample of the rolls for the café

questions.target_text: Do you have an editable copy?

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 A：他想取得可用來修改標籤的檔案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Owen 說現有標籤的數量過時，手上的檔案又被鎖定；Rina 回覆會寄出檔案讓他修改數量，可知這個問句是在間接請求可編輯的檔案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 現有檔案無法編輯，Rina 也回應會寄檔案供他修改標籤數量。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 咖啡館已更改每袋數量，而這個問句是向 Rina 詢問檔案，不是請咖啡館改單。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Owen 隨後另問訂單何時出貨；可編輯副本的問句是在處理標籤。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 對話討論的是修改標籤的檔案，沒有要求提供麵包樣品。

evidence.quote: Our label still says twelve, and the file I have is locked. Do you have an editable copy?
Yes, I’ll send you the label file so you can change the count.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 結合前面的困難與對方回應，判斷問句的實際請求。

questions.prompt: When is the order scheduled to reach Harbor Café?

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 D：明天上午八點。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Rina 在列出包裝、卡車出發與送達時間時，明確說送到咖啡館預定在八點；這些時間均屬明天早上的安排。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 今天下午四點是咖啡館需要修改後校樣的截止時間，並非配送時間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 明天上午六點開始包裝，並非訂單送達的時間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 明天上午七點十五分是卡車出發時間，並非送達時間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Rina 說配送至咖啡館預定在明天上午八點。

evidence.quote: Packing starts at 6:00 a.m. tomorrow, the truck leaves at 7:15, and delivery to the café is scheduled for 8:00.
The café needs the revised proof by 4:00 p.m. today.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨識時間時，將每個時間與它所對應的動作配對。

content.title: Reading: Market Setup Instructions
content.scenario_summary: A farmers market corrects its vehicle entrance instructions and directs vendors through check-in, utility arrangements and stall preparation.

blocks.text: Saturday Market: Vendor Setup
Please note a correction to our earlier notice: vehicles should enter through the east gate, not the north gate. The east gate opens for unloading at 7:00 a.m.

On arrival, check in with Mara at the blue desk. She will check your name against the list and give you your assigned stall number. If you need an electrical outlet, ask Mara; she can arrange a connection with the maintenance crew.
After unloading, move your vehicle to the public lot. Display a price for each item at your stall and keep the walkways clear. Please be ready to open at 9:00 a.m.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Mara’s role at the market?

options.label: A
options.text: She receives produce deliveries for vendors.

options.label: B
options.text: She helps vendors prepare their stalls.

options.label: C
options.text: She sells produce from her own stall.

explanation.summary_zh: 正確答案是 B：Mara 協助攤商準備攤位。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Mara 核對攤商名單並告知攤位號碼，也能協調維護人員接電；這兩項工作顯示她協助攤商做好設攤準備。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 說明提到 Mara 處理報到和電力協調，沒有說她代攤商收取農產品。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她提供攤位號碼並協調接電，顯示她協助攤商準備設攤。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她協助報到及安排電力，文中沒有說她自己擺攤販售農產品。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她的工作線索涉及攤位與電力，沒有提到處理顧客付款。

evidence.quote: She will check your name against the list and give you your assigned stall number.
If you need an electrical outlet, ask Mara; she can arrange a connection with the maintenance crew.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 根據同一人物的多項具體行動，推論其在活動中的角色。

questions.prompt: Which of the following are vendors NOT instructed to do before the market opens?

options.label: A
options.text: Check in at the blue desk

options.label: C
options.text: Submit a list of their stock

options.label: D

To: Front-desk staff

Following last month’s successful trial of evening luggage pickup, we will offer the service daily beginning May 12. I’m writing to explain the process before it becomes part of your regular duties.

Elena

documents.title: A useful guide for small product shoots

blocks.text: A useful guide for small product shoots
Review by Mira Tan

I run a small ceramics shop and bought Light on Small Objects to improve the photos in our catalog. Our spring catalog shoot took place on March 4. I ordered the book on March 5 and began reading it when it arrived on March 8. I wish I had found it sooner!

The chapter I keep returning to explains how a plain white card can reflect window light onto the darker side of an object. Its diagrams show exactly where to place the card, which made the setup easy to understand. The author also recommends sketching each shot in advance. That preparation paid off when I used it on a later shoot: our team finished with time to spare.

Some examples use equipment I don’t own, so I would have liked more low-cost alternatives. Still, the clear explanations helped me plan our next set of product photographs, and I would recommend the book to other small business owners.

blocks.text: Airport shuttle pickup: temporary move

Beginning June 3, the CityLink airport shuttle will pick up passengers at bay 4 in the transport center instead of at the arrivals curb. The airport is closing the curb for resurfacing, so the pickup point must move while that work is underway. Shuttle fares and departure intervals will remain the same.

From the arrivals hall, follow the orange arrows toward the transport center. [[1]] The marked route crosses a covered walkway. [[2]] At the far end, take the short flight of steps to the upper level. [[3]] The sign also displays the next departure time. [[4]] Board at bay 4 when the driver calls for passengers.

For step-free access to the upper level, use the elevator beside the steps. Staff at the information desk in the arrivals hall can help with directions. Please allow extra time to reach the new pickup point, especially if you are traveling with large bags.

blocks.text: October 8
Dear Omar,

Thank you for your work on the connection guide for passengers traveling from Eastport to the coast. As our station’s passenger information officer, you were the right person to help when the new timetable was introduced last month.

At West Junction, passengers changing to the coast train have only a short time between services. There are no departure screens in the transfer hall. That is why I asked you to hand out the guide at Eastport before passengers board. You agreed to draft a one-page guide showing the platform and departure time for the coast train, along with a small map of the transfer hall.

After the first day, you noticed that the type on the map was too small and produced a version with larger labels. Yesterday I watched two passengers use that version: both found the correct platform without asking for directions. I plan to share the revised guide with the teams at two other stations before next month’s timetable change.

Could you send me the editable file by Friday? The other teams can then update the departure times for their own services. I will also invite you to our next passenger information meeting so you can explain what you learned from preparing the guide.

Best regards,
Elena Ward
Station Manager, Eastport

content.title: A Translation Service Trial

blocks.text: A Museum Tests a Translation Service
By Julia Benton | Community Arts Review

Visitors to the Larch Museum will soon see its autumn exhibition in two languages. The museum recently tested ClearWord, a translation service, on the labels for the exhibition. After the trial, the museum recommended the service to other small museums, while advising them to leave time for their own staff to review the drafts.

Mira Hale chose the objects for the autumn display and allocated its printing budget. Before ClearWord began work, her team sent its translator a list of the names and terms already used in the museum’s existing exhibits. The translator used the list to keep the new labels consistent with those exhibits. ClearWord returned a first draft within five days, and Hale’s team then checked it against the descriptions of the objects.

The team found that a few descriptions needed clarification. They sent notes to the translator, who revised the draft. The museum held off printing the labels until the review was complete; it then sent the approved text to its printer. Hale said the exchange was helpful because the translator could ask about the objects instead of guessing what an unfamiliar term meant.

The trial covered only the autumn exhibition, not the museum’s permanent displays. Even so, Hale hopes to use the service again for a spring exhibition. She suggests that other museums prepare their reference material early and include a review period in their schedules.

blocks.text: Customer Conversations Training: Deadline Update

For frontline customer service advisers: The Training Centre has extended the deadline for completing the Customer Conversations course from November 10 to November 17. Last week, an outage prevented staff from uploading practice recordings, so the extra time will allow teams to finish the course.

Teams that submit a practice recording by November 17 will receive written feedback from a trainer, sent to their team leader. Teams that request group coaching by the same date will receive a link to book a live session. Both activities are optional.

The course also includes new case files containing examples of customer calls. Employees can add notes to these examples in a shared document that the whole team can consult later. A separate handbook lists current service policies, and sample audio recordings demonstrate ways to begin a call.

To: Training Centre
From: Leena Patel, Team Leader
Date: November 13
Subject: Our team’s course preparations

Hello Training Centre,

I am writing with an update on our customer service team’s preparations for Customer Conversations. Our advisers’ afternoons are fully booked with customer appointments. I have blocked an hour before lunch for everyone to complete the course without taking calls.

This morning I submitted our team’s practice recording through the training site. I have not requested group coaching. The staff appreciated being able to try out their responses before discussing them.

I have also booked a meeting room for the advisers to work together with the new case files after the course. They want to create a reference they can all consult afterward. Please let me know how long the course materials will remain available on the site. Thank you for your help.

Leena

blocks.text: Bring a Break to Your Workplace

BrightDesk wellness kits help employers give staff practical tools for taking breaks and staying hydrated. Each kit includes a refillable bottle and a guide to short stretches. Employers can order kits for their teams at brightdesk.example. An adviser can address questions about choosing kit components in a short online session.

If a bottle is damaged within 30 days of delivery, contact us for a replacement. Every replacement includes a 500-milliliter stainless steel bottle with a removable carry loop and a reusable fabric sleeve. Choose the Grove, which has a wide opening large enough for a hand, or the Cove, which has a narrow opening and a printed scale showing the water level.

“I like being able to wash the inside by hand, and I also like a scale that shows how much water is in the bottle,” says Tara Walsh, benefits coordinator at Heston Design. Her team helped test the first kits.

To: Heston Design staff
From: Tara Walsh
Date: November 18
Subject: My BrightDesk bottle

Hello everyone,

I wanted to share my experience with the bottle in our BrightDesk kit. Mine started leaking because a seam had cracked, so I contacted BrightDesk to request a replacement. I selected the Cove model, and it arrived yesterday.

The replacement is stainless steel, holds 500 milliliters, and has a removable carry loop. It arrived in a cardboard box with no fabric sleeve inside. I have contacted BrightDesk about the packaging and will pass along its response when I hear back.

The stretch guide has already been useful during our afternoon breaks. If you have questions about the kit, please send them to me before Friday so I can collect them for the next staff meeting.

Tara

blocks.text: City Buildings Conference — October 21

Join architects, building managers, and community groups for a day of practical discussions at the Marlow Conference Center. Registration includes the afternoon case study, Retrofitting on a Budget. The full program and accessibility information are available at the registration desk.

Revised program: Retrofitting on a Budget will now begin at 2:00 p.m., followed by audience questions at 2:45 and a break at 3:15. The session had previously been scheduled to begin after the break. Other sessions remain at their published times.

For Retrofitting on a Budget, volunteer teams will wear badges in their assigned colors so attendees can find the right help. The Blue Team collects written questions for the chair, the Green Team hands out session notes, the Orange Team helps attendees find seats, and the Yellow Team distributes feedback forms. All participants are welcome to visit the resource tables during the break.

From: Nora Bell

Subject: Program update

Nora

blocks.text: StandWorks — Try a Trade Fair Display Package

Preparing for the October 9 Northbridge Trade Fair? Try a StandWorks display package before deciding whether to rent it for another event. We deliver the trial package on October 8 and collect it on October 11. Exhibitors can arrange their products on the display before the fair opens.

StandWorks Trial Feedback | Submitted October 12
Exhibitor: Greenbank Ceramics | Contact: Mina Park

What worked well?
The orientation made assembly straightforward, and the sign holder was easy to reposition. Our products were visible from the main aisle.

What would you change for your next fair?
We used one wide lamp during the trial. For the November fair, please supply two small lamps, one floor mat, and one power strip. We do not have any of these items for that event yet.

Please send the equipment to our office, not to the fair venue. Our office receives deliveries between 9:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. A colleague will check the items before we pack the display for the trip. Thank you for helping us test the package.

Thank you for the comments about the trial. We will keep your feedback on file as we prepare for the November fair. If your office delivery hours change, please let me know so that I can update the driver’s instructions.

Theo Grant

documents.title: A Busy Spring at Fieldstone Print

blocks.text: A Busy Spring at Fieldstone Print
By Lena Marsh | April 3 | Eastside Business News

Fieldstone Print is preparing for a busy spring of community projects. On May 8, the shop has reserved Press B for printing posters for the Eastside Fair throughout the morning. Press A is scheduled to produce booklets for a neighborhood garden group that afternoon.

Customers considering a project can examine paper samples at the front counter. Design consultations take place in the studio, while completed orders are collected at the pickup desk. The press room is open to visitors during scheduled tours, when staff explain how a print job moves from proof to finished product.

Manager Rosa Lee says the shop works closely with local organizations on deadlines and materials. Customers can bring their own artwork or discuss a design with the shop’s team. The staff also check proofs with customers before beginning a print run.

From: Rosa Lee
To: Fieldstone production team
Date: April 6
Subject: Museum map order
Hello team,

The museum has asked us to print maps for its upcoming opening. The opening is approaching, and the maps must use the large sheets specified by the museum. Of our presses, only Press B can handle that sheet size. Please check whether Press B could be available for the maps on May 8; before changing any reservations, tell me what other work would be affected.

The paper delivery has arrived. Please set aside the large sheets for the museum order so they will be available when we schedule the job. The museum will send its final map artwork next week. We can review a proof with its staff before printing.

Separately, the Eastside Fair committee approved its poster proofs on April 5. Before we finalize the poster run schedule, we need both the committee’s approval and the cutting machine cleared for use; the completed posters will be cut to size on it. The approved files are in the shared folder. Please keep them there so that the production team can locate them when the poster run is scheduled.

Thank you,
Rosa
Fieldstone Print — Production Notice
Issued April 8 | For production staff

For the morning of May 8, Press B is reserved for the museum maps. This notice replaces earlier press reservations for that date. The production team should confirm that the final map artwork is ready before starting the run.

The cutting machine was inspected and cleared for use on April 7. Staff may use it for the fair posters and museum maps after printing. Please keep finished work for each customer together and label it before moving it to the pickup desk.
The Eastside Fair posters will be printed on Press A on May 9. Notify the fair committee when the posters are ready for collection. The garden group’s booklet schedule is unchanged.
